messages:
taylor: quick async — API platform checkin
- did: landed gw route fallback PR (#732) that adds policy priority override
- blocker: flaky jwt-refresh e2e failing in staging (~10%); suspect token cache TTL mismatch
- today: will run canary deploy for new routing-policy + triage e2e

morgan: thx taylor. saw the PR. can you post the config you're rolling?

taylor: sure, config snippet:
```
route: /v1/llm/*
policies:
  - id: pref_auth
    priority: 100
    actions: allow
  - id: fallback_small
    priority: 50
    actions: route:dedicated-small
```

sam: re: flaky jwt-refresh — I pushed a fix to session-cache last night, but not rolled into staging image yet. i'll queue a rebuild @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: Build queued: image=redwood/session-cache:fix/jwt-ttl, CI run=2114

riley: FYI I've noticed increased 429s on the inference edge when burst >1200 rps. probably need to tweak token bucket defaults. opened issue #1284

jas: looping in @lee for rate-limit knobs

lee: looking. can we lower default burst to 800 for the canary region us-west-2? that'll prevent queueing spikes and keep p95 latency under 120ms

morgan: +1 for region-specific defaults. taylor are you okay with that for today's canary?

taylor: yes, go ahead with 800 for us-west-2. i'll annotate the rollout doc and set a canary window 15m -> increase to 1000 if stable

sam: queued rebuild finished — image pushed. staging deploy scheduled for 12:15 UTC

riley: also quick code-review ping @morgan on PR #735 (policy evaluator refactor). small comment about null handling

morgan: reviewing now. should merge today if tests pass :eyeglasses:

taylor: blockers summary: jwt-refresh e2e in staging (sam rollback ppl working), monitoring alerts for 429 spike (riley investigating). otherwise on track for canary

lee: I'll patch rate limit defaults and post diff to #config-reviews

taylor: thanks all. ping me in thread if 429s spike during the canary. :thumbsup:
